key_findings: Questionnaire paths for S1 are the same in 2018, 2020, 2022: Yes skips S2 and proceeds to S5; No/DK/Refused routes to S2. No explicit no-response interviewer route is documented.
Record-layout PES2 edited universe includes PES1=-9, but this does not prove PES2 was asked or answered for those records.
The 2022 PES1 valid-value listing omits -9 while PES2 edited universe includes it; treated as documentation inconsistency, not a changed question path.
The year-specific 2018/2020 pages inspected do not list a distinct replicate-weight section; this does not prove such files do not exist elsewhere. The 2022 page does list one.
No supplement weight/use PWSSWGT is point-weight guidance and does not resolve replicate-weight availability.
Previous blanket claim about person replicate weights in all 2018–2024 supplements is superseded as unsupported. Older year availability/vintage requires separate source check.

supersedes.claim: CPS Voting Supplement microdata are available for election years including 2018–2024, with state identifiers and person replicate weights.
supersedes.correction: The all-years replicate-weight assertion is unsupported by the inspected year-specific pages and must not be used as established. No claim of nonexistence is made.

limits: No microdata or replicate-weight payload was acquired, hashed, or inspected.
Current archive listing and page revision metadata do not prove original file-release dates or exact past vintages.
Published summary-table release dates do not certify raw-file release timing.
Record layouts describe edited values/universes; questionnaire routing describes asked paths. Neither alone proves every field was observed for every eligible record.
